chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: New Jersey, 1999. The first game of the Women’s World Cup: USA against Denmark. Brandi Chastain floats a long ball. Mia Hamm brings it down, pops it over a defender... and scores!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Hamm traps it on her chest. She flicks it over Katrine Pedersen and runs round her.

chapters.label: Left foot
chapters.text: Left foot! She fires it past the keeper’s hand, just under the bar. Nearly eighty thousand fans go wild!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: run at defenders with confidence. Keep your eyes up, and when you see the gap, finish!
